text: Were animals really put on trial?
Yes. Weevils were eating a village's vines, so the village took them to court.
And the court gave the weevils a lawyer.
He argued that God made the animals before man, and gave them every green herb to eat.
So the village offered the weevils a field of their own, away from the vines.
The villagers could still walk through it, and use its water.
But the weevils' lawyer said no. The land was too barren for his clients.
So the court sent experts to inspect the field.
Lost. The last page of the record is missing.
Nobody knows. But yes: animals really were put on trial.
